testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the ribbon locations of an available command: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:792:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the ribbon locations of an available command ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user clicks "2D Sketches" in the available command list ✔ And the user presses End and then Home while the pointer remains over that row ✔ Then a tooltip for "2D Sketches" lists its Part and Assembly locations ✔ And both locations identify the View tab and Visibility panel ✔ And the target custom panel remains empty ✔ When the user clicks Close ✔ Then the dialog closes
